meta.name: Quantum Explorer
meta.shortDescription: Dogecoin blockchain explorer with Core RPC indexer and PQ transaction metrics
meta.longDescription: Quantum Explorer runs PostgreSQL inside the pup (embedded when QE_POSTGRES_URL is unset), indexes every block and transaction from Dogecoin Core via RPC into local tables, and serves a Comic Neue + Material Icons web UI. Search supports address, txid, block height, and block hash. Post-quantum signals are classified from decoded raw transaction bytes (OP_RETURN markers). Optional libdogecoin SPV and P2P mempool tracking are off by default; set QE_SPV_AUTO_START=1 or QE_MEMPOOL_AUTO_START=1 to enable legacy paths. Configure Dogecoin Core RPC (QE_CORE_RPC_*) for indexing; link the core-rpc interface from the Dogecoin Core pup when available.

sections.name: Web
sections.description: HTTP port is inside the container; open the URL Dogebox shows for this pup.

fields.name: QE_EXPLORER_TX_API
fields.label: Optional: tx API URL with {txid} (legacy mempool path only)

sections.name: Embedded PostgreSQL
sections.description: Persistent data lives under QE_STORAGE_DIR (same pattern as pq-wallet’s PQ_STORAGE_DIR). If QE_POSTGRES_URL is empty, PostgreSQL data and sockets are created there and database quantum_explorer is created.

fields.name: QE_POSTGRES_URL
fields.label: Optional: override Postgres URL (leave empty for embedded)

sections.name: Dogecoin Core RPC
sections.description: Required for full-chain indexing. Read-only RPC. Point QE_CORE_RPC_URL at your Core node (dependency interface core-rpc when linked).

sections.name: Optional SPV and mempool
sections.description: Legacy libdogecoin SPV and P2P mempool indexer; disabled by default.

sections.name: Access and Security
sections.description: Admin routes use token in URL. Public APIs can be token-gated by path.

fields.name: QE_PUBLIC_API_TOKEN
fields.label: Optional: token for protected public APIs

fields.name: QE_PUBLIC_API_ALLOWLIST
fields.label: Optional: IPs for protected public APIs

fields.name: QE_PUBLIC_RATE_LIMIT
fields.label: Public API requests per IP per window
